Its three-way research coupling is Swarm Coordination x Spatial Topology x Settlement Formation. The proposed apparatus comprises instrumented modules, surveyed reference geometry, guarded laboratory infrastructure, and bounded hardware-in-the-loop tests; it is neither a finished city nor an inhabited building. The predeclared candidate claim is that a frozen local-negotiation policy can improve independently measured load redistribution without unacceptable deterioration in measured water mass closure, under matched material, energy, sensing, communication, operator, and time budgets. The key initial water relation is Delta S_w = Q_in - Q_use - Q_loss - Q_out, where every volume term is assigned to the same measurement interval. Strong alternatives include a fixed modular camp with centralized utilities and manual docking, centrally planned deployment, and competent supervised operation. Blinded challenges deliberately introduce connector loss, delayed communication, common-reference bias, support changes, water-bypass flow, altered service demand, and failed safe separation. A positive final geometry is not sufficient to pass. Thirty distinct research plates cover typed multilayer graphs, consensus under switching connectivity, registration covariance, robot separation barriers, formation assignment and makespan, support and joint mechanics, load redistribution, electrical power islands, storage and current budgets, hydraulic mass continuity, service minimums, correlated uncertainty, complete-denominator qualification, and verified physical stopping. Each plate states a mathematical object, dimensional or logical assumptions, a specific blind counterexample, a scientific limit, and chapter interfaces. Related literature is explicitly bounded to component mechanisms; no isolated source validates this integrated F47 proposal. Eighty-two chapters contain 410 separately paginated research investigations, organized around the mechanisms, measurements, equal-resource comparisons, blinded adversarial tests, and independent succession of six-node settlement formation. Two hundred distinct Research Gates investigate hidden faults, strong competing arrangements, interdependent service failures, noncompensatory hard vetoes, and cross-generation reconstruction. Thirty-three different Phoenix Answer Embryos propose specialized future instruments and evidence tools, each with a separate testable failure condition. The volume is a catalogue of falsifiable research designs rather than a claim of completed trials. This edition is prospective, scaled, and strictly non-occupancy. Structural performance, fire protection, potable-water safety, ventilation, human evacuation, building-code compliance, and habitability require independent real-world programs and are not established here. Physical stop, support truth, calibrated utility balances, module identity, and current human permission cannot be traded away for apparent coordination efficiency. Methodological references include DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-60982-0 (tensegrity-block modular structures), 10.1038/s44172-026-00715-3 (flying swarm formation), 10.1109/TCST.2024.3378989 (distributed microgrid controllers), 10.1109/JPROC.2006.887293 (network consensus), 10.1126/scirobotics.aau8479 (collective construction), and related reviews and allocation methods. It asks whether polymer networks, repairable composites and carefully bounded regenerative materials can recover measurable cohesion and environmental barrier function over repeated damage-repair cycles without concealing material replenishment, unmetered energy or progressive loss of reliability. Its core coupling is Self-Healing Polymers x Material Regeneration x Cyclic Reliability. Research is restricted to coded material coupons, scaled unoccupied habitat seams, guarded environmental chambers and controlled instrumented tests; no inhabitable building, certified structural material or autonomous field repair is asserted. The falsifiable candidate predicts improved all-attempt qualified repair success without increased maintenance energy under matched damage severity, material feed, heating, cure time, sensing, inspection and independent testing resources. The strongest alternatives are correctly performed conventional adhesive repair, scheduled replacement, nonhealing chemistry and active-treatment shams, not weak untreated controls. Blind challenges include depleted reversible groups, hidden adhesive delamination, shifted catalyst or material lot, altered crack geometry, breached vapor seals, elevated emissions and late-cycle fatigue. A visually closed crack does not count as restored fracture resistance. The original source contract's survival function, S(t)=exp[-integral h(u) du], is treated as a conditional reliability model for a defined at-risk population, not as a new law of self-healing; changed failure mechanisms invalidate naive accelerated-life extrapolation. Thirty mathematically distinct research plates cover hazard and competing risks, fracture-energy recovery, dynamic bond kinetics, polymer relaxation and diffusion, reaction-diffusion, capsule mass balance, heating work, interface fracture, fatigue, barrier transport, chemistry equivalents, correlated measurement uncertainty, complete-denominator yield, severe-tail risk and noncompensatory physical acceptance. Each plate gives a conditional construction, variables and units, one mechanism-specific blind test and linked research chapters. Eighty-two chapters and 410 separately paginated studies distinguish chemical identity, real fracture contact, reversible bonds, capsule and vascular healing, composite and cementitious pathways, humidity and weathering, fire and indoor-air screening, stimulus energy, cycle-dependent damage, survival analysis and independent replication. Two hundred individually differentiated Research Gates challenge concealed material faults, strong resource-matched comparators and coupled structural-chemical failures. Thirty-three distinguishable Phoenix Answer Embryos propose new reference fixtures, spectroscopic witnesses, capsule inventories, thermochemical ledgers, humidity and fracture tools, tail-risk dossiers, retirement controls and cross-generation evidence interfaces. These items are research candidates, not built or qualified autonomous devices. The F42 contract requires repeatable mechanical recovery, credible barrier and air measurements, explicit stopping rules and correct inclusion of failed or withdrawn samples; the ability to refuse unsafe release is an intended scientific result. This is a nonoccupancy, hypothesis-forming scientific design edition, not an experimental proof of self-regenerating architecture or a fire, health, water or building certification. Methodological precedents include polymer glass healing simulations (DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-59426-6), dynamic polyurethane reprocessing (DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-68263-6), recurrent shape-memory-assisted polymer healing (DOI 10.1038/s41467-023-40340-8), dynamic hydrogen bonding (DOI 10.1038/s41467-021-20931-z), self-healing electronic skin (DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-53957-0), ASTM fatigue methodology (DOI 10.1520/E0647-24) and composite tensile testing (DOI 10.1520/D3039_D3039M-17R25). title: QIGONG BREATHING AND INTELLIGENT ACUPUNCTURE NEUROFEEDBACK COUPLING AT THE LIMIT is a 777-page English Research Working Edition that constructs a falsifiable, explicitly nonclinical research program joining measured breathing tasks, cardiorespiratory and EEG feedback, and isolated microscale actuator surrogates. The central problem is not whether breathing changes heart-rate variability - that has established ordinary physiological explanations - but whether a proposed feedback architecture adds independently measurable predictive or benchtop-control value after breathing rate, phase, expectancy, ordinary cardiorespiratory dynamics, sensor calibration, stimulus timing and strong conventional controllers have been fairly matched. The primary hypothesis is deliberately narrow. A prospective factorial design separates a preregistered breathing condition from an isolated, non-human phantom-drive condition. Its interaction term, order effects, washout, hierarchical sampling units, pressure-related mechanisms and full-episode denominators are subjected to masked scheduling, matched sham sensory cues, covariance-aware uncertainty and independent laboratory reconstruction. Any apparent signal explained by paced breathing or cue entrainment is treated as a legitimate negative result. A bench interaction is not evidence of physiological effects from actual acupuncture in a person. Thirty mathematically differentiated research plates address factorial contrasts, hierarchical estimands, respiratory sinus arrhythmia, ECG event genealogy, pressure-respiration transfer, spectral coherence, lag and phase, multiple comparisons, uncertainty covariance, causal identification, feedback latency, safe-state projection, isolated charge and thermal constraints, abstention and provenance. Across 82 chapters and 410 separately paginated scientific investigations, the book examines operational breathing definitions, reference instruments, EEG and ECG artifacts, blinded feedback protocols, mechanical and electrical phantoms, strong ordinary competitors, statistics, safety vetoes and reproducible handoff. Two hundred full-page Research Gates place their complete falsifiable research question in large deep-navy type, followed by an independently measurable outcome, adverse experiment, conventional physical rival and stopping rule. Thirty-three Phoenix Answer Embryos propose distinct successor objects ranging from calibration bridges and sham credibility tests to independent hardware vetoes, covariance sentinels, multisite reference capsules and protected null-result archives. An accompanying Excel index links formulas, chapters, Gates, candidate objects, citations and explicit evidence limitations. This work reports no executed integrated experiments, in-human needling, electrical stimulation, clinical efficacy, diagnosis or regulatory authorization. Its three STARLI mother-volume DOIs establish author research-method ancestry. Thirteen separately identified external research and metrology DOIs support established measurement, breathing physiology, neurofeedback reporting, uncertainty and statistical methodology, not the novel combined hypothesis. The 777-page layout, formula-clearance checks and 200 Gate color checks were automated; recurring editorial phrasing remains and full independent scientific peer review has not taken place.
